heading: Today
text: Morning showers will taper off, but some localized showers or a few rumbles of thunder will re-develop this afternoon, especially from the Green Mountains east.  Breaks of afternoon sun in the St. Lawrence into the Adirondacks, with a chance of a few showers.  Highs in the low to mid 70s.  Winds northeast, becoming north up to 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any scattered showers ending.  Partial clearing, with areas of locally dense fog developing. Lows in the 50s to near 60, low 60s in the Champlain Valley.  Winds north near 10 mph, becoming light.

heading: Friday
text: Areas of fog burning off to a mix of clouds and sunshine.  A few scattered afternoon showers, mostly east of the Green Mountains.  Highs in the 70s to low 80s.  Winds light, mainly northwest less than 10 mph.
